name: Premier Paints Plc
source: CRON 2026-11-21: Premier Paints Plc unaudited statement of profit or loss for the third quarter ended 30 September 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), Jan-Sep 2026 column, printed in thousands of naira and scaled to naira. Revenue less Cost of Sales equals the printed gross profit of 7,634 thousand and profit before tax less nil income tax equals the printed loss after taxation of 12,812 thousand. Operating Expenses is the sum of the printed selling and distribution expenses of 7,948 thousand and administration expenses of 12,498 thousand. EPS is the printed loss per share of 0.10 kobo. | Premier Paints Plc audited report and financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (NGX corporate disclosure, quarter 5 filing, March 2026). Revenue, profit before tax, income tax, profit after tax and earnings per share are the audited five-year financial summary on page 52; cost of sales is note 4.1 on page 41 and replaces an earlier stored row that carried the depreciation charge from note 4.5
unit: NGN, printed in N thousands and converted to naira; earnings per share as printed (the report labels the row kobo, but 1,993 on 123,000 thousand shares is 0.0162 naira, which the audited summary prints as 0.02)

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Gross Profit
rows.derivedFrom: Gross Profit = Revenue - Cost of Sales

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Profit Before Tax - Income Tax = Net Profit, and the column ties with it positive

derivation.note: rows tagged derived are arithmetic on the filed figures, not printed in the source. Cost of Sales was corrected: the stored row carried the 7,791 and 7,954 thousand naira depreciation charge disclosed in note 4.5 as cost of sales, which printed a 94.74 percent gross margin; note 4.1 states cost of sales of 111,552 and 102,738 thousand naira

reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025, FY2024: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged.
